objective: Print to ragesaq's NIIMBOT printer over Bluetooth directly from Thermalith — a real driver-style transport, replacing dependence on the vendor phone app — and contribute that capability (and follow-on enhancements) upstream as PRs.
firstTarget: BLE implementation of INiimbotTransport in Niimbot.Net, per upstream issue #13.
successCriteria: Thermalith discovers, connects to, and prints on ragesaq's NIIMBOT printer over Bluetooth end-to-end (design -> render -> print), no vendor app involved.
The transport is a clean INiimbotTransport implementation: framing/commands/client untouched; works on at least the desktop OS ragesaq uses, with a credible cross-platform story.
The work is accepted upstream (PR merged into the GitLab upstream via the GitHub mirror flow) or is in active upstream review with maintainer engagement.
Every session leaves .agents/ memory current enough that a cold session can resume without chat history.
constraints: Upstream-first: match upstream conventions (CONTRIBUTING.md, CLAUDE.md architecture notes); one logical change per PR; DCO sign-off on every upstream-bound commit.
GPL-3.0-or-later inbound=outbound; porting logic from MIT-licensed reference implementations is OK with provenance noted.
Fork main carries meta files (AGENTS.md, .agents/); PR branches start from upstream/main so meta never leaks into PRs.
Commit identity in this fork is ragesaq only.
mustNever: Commit as any identity other than ragesaq in this fork.
Edit upstream-owned files (e.g. CLAUDE.md) in fork-meta commits.
Merge PRs — the upstream maintainer lands all changes.
